notes: mc GEOGRAPHY basis: revenue by region is by SALES location (10-K Note 16, 10-Q Note 14: United States, China, Other international); long-lived assets by location of the asset (United States and Other international; the 10-K also split out Germany, the 10-Q no longer does). China assets are never split out, so the country-risk row rests on China revenue share plus the plant capacity table, not on China assets. Evidence: pf_10q_20261022, pf_10k_20260129.

mc GEOGRAPHY derived shares of total revenue (my arithmetic on the mc_rev_* facts): FY2023 US 46.7% / China 22.5% / Other int'l 30.8%; FY2024 48.9% / 21.4% / 29.7%; FY2025 50.2% / 22.1% / 27.7%; nine months 2025 52.5% / 20.4% / 27.1%; nine months 2026 46.2% / 17.9% / 35.9%; Q3-2026 44.5% / 18.6% / 36.9% vs Q3-2025 52.0% / 20.1% / 27.9%. Evidence: mc_rev_us_fy25, mc_rev_cn_fy25, mc_rev_oi_fy25, mc_rev_us_9m26, mc_rev_cn_9m26, mc_rev_oi_9m26, mc_rev_us_q326, mc_rev_cn_q326, mc_rev_oi_q326.

mc GEOGRAPHY derived growth: Q3-2026 vs Q3-2025 United States -14.4%, China -7.9%, Other international +31.8% (total -0.2%: 28,046 vs 28,095 $M); nine months 2026 vs 2025 United States -1.0%, China -1.4%, Other international +49.1% (total +12.5%). The whole nine-month growth in revenue came from Other international; China revenue is flat to down while China-built vehicles are exported (see mc EXPOSURE China). Evidence: mc_rev_us_q326, mc_rev_us_q325, mc_rev_cn_q326, mc_rev_cn_q325, mc_rev_oi_q326, mc_rev_oi_q325, mc_rev_us_9m26, mc_rev_us_9m25, mc_rev_cn_9m26, mc_rev_cn_9m25, mc_rev_oi_9m26, mc_rev_oi_9m25.

mc GEOGRAPHY long-lived assets: United States 82.2% of the total at 2026-09-30 ($45.24B of $55.04B) vs 79.2% at 2025-12-31; US assets grew 26.2% in nine months ($35.85B to $45.24B) while Other international grew 4.3% ($9.40B to $9.80B). The asset base is being built in the US (Texas Megafactory and Cortex compute, Nevada cells) while a larger share of revenue is earned abroad (Other international plus China = 53.8% of nine-month revenue). Evidence: mc_lla_us_sep26, mc_lla_oi_sep26, mc_lla_tot_sep26, mc_lla_us_dec25, mc_lla_oi_dec25, mc_lla_tot_dec25.

mc GEOGRAPHY installed annual capacity by region (Q3-2026 shareholder update, manufacturing slide; 'installed capacity' is not output): vehicles California Model 3/Y >550k, Shanghai Model 3/Y >950k, Berlin Model Y >375k, Texas Model Y >375k + Cybertruck >125k + Cybercab >125k, Nevada Semi 25k, i.e. Shanghai about 37.6% of the listed vehicle capacity (950 of 2,525 thousand, floors of the '>' figures). Megapack: California 40 GWh, Shanghai 20 GWh, Texas 50 GWh (Texas began production in Q3-2026), i.e. Shanghai about 18.2% of the 110 GWh. Cells: Nevada LFP 7 GWh (early ramp), Texas 4680 >40 GWh, cathode 10 GWh and lithium refining 30 GWh (early ramp), Berlin 4680 under construction. Evidence: pf_rel_20261021_1.

mc EXPOSURE China (demand and a plant): China is 22.1% of FY2025 revenue and 17.9% of nine-month 2026 revenue, falling; Shanghai holds about 37.6% of listed vehicle capacity and 18.2% of Megapack capacity; the 10-K says operations in China and Europe create risk from trade restrictions, tariffs and exchange controls and that it cannot predict changes to trade agreements with China. Debt in China: the China Working Capital Facility stood at $5,966M at 2026-09-30 (RMB facility, rate 2.01-2.11%, borrowings maturing Oct 2026 to Sep 2027, no unused committed amount in the table) vs $4,288M with $1,429M unused at 2025-12-31 (10-K: RMB 20.00B facility raised by a further RMB 20.00B in Sep 2025). Candidate bear mechanism, sized from the evidenced shares above: a China-demand or China-policy shock acts on about a fifth of revenue and about 38% of vehicle capacity. Evidence: mc_rev_cn_fy25, mc_rev_cn_9m26, mc_cnwc_sep26, mc_cnwc_dec25, pf_10k_20260129, pf_10q_20261022, pf_rel_20261021_1.

mc EXPOSURE China exports (press lead, preliminary CPCA data via CnEVPost, not confirmed at CPCA): Shanghai wholesale 95,366 vehicles in Sep 2026, exports 30,529 (+58.3% YoY), China retail 64,837 (-9.35% YoY); nine months wholesale 743,060 (+22.5%), of which domestic 381,088 and exports 361,972 (exports 48.7% of wholesale, my arithmetic). This fits the filing: Other international revenue +49.1% in nine months while China revenue is -1.4%. Hypothesis, not a fact: Shanghai now serves mainly non-China demand, so the plant is exposed to the destination markets' tariffs (EU, others) as much as to China demand. Evidence: mc_press_cpca_sep26, mc_rev_oi_9m26, mc_rev_cn_9m26.

mc EXPOSURE tariffs, ONE-OFF in Q3-2026 (flag for quarter review and the earnings base): after the US Supreme Court ruling of February 2026 invalidating certain IEEPA tariffs, Tesla recognized refunds in Q3-2026 of $526M (reduction of energy cost of revenues), $260M (reduction of automotive sales cost of revenues) and booked $339M as a REDUCTION of energy revenue for refunds contractually owed to certain energy storage customers; amounts in H1-2026 were immaterial. Net benefit to Q3 gross profit about $447M (526 + 260 - 339, my arithmetic, assuming each line lands fully in gross profit) against Q3-2026 GAAP gross profit of $5,494M and income from operations of $718M, i.e. about 8.1% of gross profit and about 62% of operating income. Energy gross profit of $954M includes +$187M net (526 - 339); automotive gross profit of $4,540M includes +$260M. Whether more refunds are still to come is not stated (gap). Evidence: mc_ieepa_energy_cogs_q326, mc_ieepa_auto_cogs_q326, mc_ieepa_energy_rev_q326, pf_10q_20261022, pf_rel_20261021_1.

mc EXPOSURE tariffs, ONGOING and OBBBA (energy storage is the bigger exposure): management says the current tariff regime has a relatively larger impact on energy generation and storage than on automotive, and that US import tariffs and the One Big Beautiful Bill Act provisions 'could significantly increase battery cell expenses' (10-Q). Energy is 10.7% of nine-month 2026 revenue ($8,428M of $78,669M) and 17.0% of the two segments' nine-month gross profit ($2,546M of $14,965M), my arithmetic. Localization is only starting: the first Megapack with LFP cells made at Gigafactory Nevada shipped in Q3-2026 and Nevada LFP cell capacity is 7 GWh (early ramp) against 110 GWh of installed Megapack capacity (about 6%). The share of cells or cost of goods imported from China and the tariff rate applied to it are NOT disclosed: any tariff bear case for Megapack is a HYPOTHESIS sized only by the 17.0% gross-profit share. 10-K risk factors: tariffs 'have impacted our supply chain costs', some parts for lithium-ion batteries 'are difficult or impossible to source within the United States'. Evidence: pf_10q_20261022, pf_10k_20260129, pf_rel_20261021_1.

mc EXPOSURE supply chain (unsized, hypothesis): the 10-K names single-source direct suppliers, retaliatory export controls and component shortages, and says AI compute, memory, energy and thermal resources may prove insufficient in scale or affordability. No Taiwan, TSMC or named foundry exposure appears in the 10-K or the 10-Q text (searched), and no export-control regime that applies to Tesla's own sales is named; the exposure is generic and cannot be sized from the filings. Evidence: pf_10k_20260129 (Item 1A), pf_10q_20261022.

mc EXPOSURE regulation and litigation of autonomy (Item 1A and Note 11 of the 10-Q): ongoing information requests and subpoenas from NHTSA, NTSB, SEC and DOJ on topics including ADAS and Robotaxi, no agency has concluded wrongdoing; Benavides v. Tesla (S.D. Fla.) jury award of $129M compensatory (Tesla 33% at fault) plus $200M punitive, post-trial motions denied 2026-02-19, appeal to the Eleventh Circuit with Tesla's reply due 2026-11-06, accrual 'immaterial' (the total award of $329M is about 46% of Q3-2026 operating income, my arithmetic); securities class action in W.D. Texas on Autopilot, FSD and Robotaxi statements (motion to dismiss fully briefed); a California class of consumers (limited class certified 2025-08-18) and a new proposed class action filed 2026-06-04 on driver-assistance claims; the California Civil Rights Department trial (equitable phase) runs 2026-09-21 to 2026-10-30; EEOC suit in discovery. Delaware derivative suits were dismissed 2026-04-13 and are on appeal. Losses are not estimable per the filing. Evidence: pf_10q_20261022.

mc EXPOSURE currency (reported): the dollar weakened over the period (positive effect on automotive revenue; Q3 FX transaction loss of $302M in the cash flow statement, with $312M in Q2 and $287M in Q1; 10-Q notes an unfavourable cost effect from the weaker dollar on automotive cost of sales). Evidence: pf_10q_20261022, pf_rel_20261021_1.

mc MACRO rates and regime (context only, never moves a value): FRED DGS10 5.00% on 2026-10-23 (4.96% on 10-22, 5.13% on 10-21), used as the risk-free rate 0.05 already in the prefetch; VIX 18.39 on 2026-10-26 (19.45 on 10-23); Baa corporate spread over the 10-year 1.47% on 2026-10-23; 10-year minus 2-year spread +0.32 points on 2026-10-26. Equity risk premium kept as the prefetch's 4.2% (Damodaran implied ERP, 2026-10-01, treasury 5.29% then): that is the latest monthly update on or before 2026-10-27, so no change to market.risk_free or market.equity_risk_premium. Evidence: pf_fred_dgs10, pf_erp_implied, mc_fred_vix, mc_fred_baa10y, mc_fred_t10y2y.

mc NEWS 2026-10-22 (10-Q filed, latest periodic filing; evidence pf_10q_20261022): capital expenditures expected 'in excess of $20 billion in 2026' (10-Q liquidity section); $13.01B spent in nine months; cash and short-term investments $45.45B at 2026-09-30; nine-month operating cash flow $14.90B. Press (not verified by me) says the earlier guide was 'more than $25 billion' and that the call said about $20B; the filing wording is a floor, not a point. The capex path belongs to the numbers lane.

mc NEWS 2026-10-21 (Q3-2026 results 8-K, items 2.02/9.01; evidence pf_rel_20261021_1): revenue $28,046M flat year on year, GAAP operating income $718M, new capacity table shows Houston Megafactory (50 GWh Megapack) in production, FSD approved in nine EU countries (four added since Q2: Croatia, Slovenia, Czech Republic, Slovakia), cumulative unsupervised Robotaxi miles reported. Details belong to the documents lane; citable now (6 days old).
mc NEWS 2026-10-19 (proxy statement DEF 14A filed, annual meeting 2026-12-03; evidence pf_proxy_20261019): governance and pay matters for the documents lane, not read in this lane.

mc NEWS 2026-10-09 (CPCA preliminary data, press lead via CnEVPost; evidence mc_press_cpca_sep26): Shanghai had its best month of 2026 on exports; China retail fell 9.35% YoY (see mc EXPOSURE China exports).

mc NEWS 2026-10-02 (8-K, items 2.02/9.01; evidence pf_rel_20261002_1): Q3-2026 production, deliveries and deployments release: produced 464,391 vehicles, delivered 486,532 (Model 3/Y 478,237, other models 8,295) and deployed 13.7 GWh of storage; the numbers lane owns the KPIs.

mc NEWS 2026-09-29 (8-K items 1.01, 1.02, 2.03, 9.01; evidence mc_8k_20260929): Tesla entered a new $20.0B senior unsecured three-year delayed draw term loan (up to ten draws in 18 months, undrawn commitment stepping down to $10.0B at 12 months and $5.0B at 15 months, loans mature 2029-09-29), an $8.0B five-year revolver (to 2031-09-29, two one-year extensions, accordion of up to $4.0B across both revolvers) and a $2.0B 364-day revolver (to 2027-09-28); the $5.0B 2023 revolver (to 2028-01-20) was terminated with no borrowings and no penalty. No loans were outstanding on 2026-09-29 and the company 'does not currently plan to draw on the facilities in 2026'; covenant of at least $5.0B consolidated liquidity plus customary lien and subsidiary-debt limits. Total committed credit rises from $5.0B to $30.0B, a funding-capacity fact to carry into the funding and dilution link of the forecast; it is capacity, not a draw.

mc NEWS 2026-10 unconfirmed leads (press search excerpts, publication dates not captured, to be confirmed at the source before any use): (1) NHTSA defect petition DP26010 opened 2026-10-09 on Robotaxi speed in school zones (Model Y and Cybercab; decision on a formal probe due about 2027-01-21), a Special Order from NHTSA asking Tesla to certify under oath that the pedal-less, wheel-less Cybercab meets federal standards (answers due 2026-09-30), and an FSD traffic-violation probe opened October 2025 covering about 2.9 million vehicles; (2) ACEA/Dataforce September 2026 registrations: Tesla about 68,776 in EU+EFTA+UK (+72.5% YoY, 5.0% share) after two years of decline; (3) a Jalopnik newsletter of 2026-10-22 mentions Tesla wanting to put Cybercabs on showroom floors despite the NHTSA investigation. A NHTSA decision against the Cybercab certification would stop the purpose-built Robotaxi plan, but its probability and timing are a hypothesis.

mc NEWS 8-Ks since the latest periodic filing: the filings list (refreshed by the prefetch at 2026-10-27T16:10Z, SEC user agent set) shows no 8-K filed after the 2026-10-21 results 8-K, so there is none between the 10-Q of 2026-10-22 and 2026-10-27. Searches found no Tesla-specific BIS, USTR, EU or MOFCOM action dated October 2026 (the only China item found was a MOFCOM warning of 2026-10-19 about possible UK limits on Chinese EVs, not about Tesla).

Share of battery cells and other components imported from China, and the tariff rate on them, are not disclosed: the Megapack tariff bear case is a hypothesis sized only by energy's 17.0% share of nine-month gross profit

Equity risk premium kept at the saved Damodaran value of 2026-10-01 (4.2%); DGS10 of 2026-10-26 was not yet published in the saved FRED file (last row 2026-10-23)
